17802.commentary: (VINa) gāmo ek'ūpacāro'ti-ādi avippavāsa-lakkhaṇa-vavatthāpan'atthaṃ vuttaṃ. tato paraṃ yathākkamena tān'eva pannarasa mātikāpadāni vitthārento gāmo ek'ūpacāro nāmā'tiādim'āha.

examples.text: gāmo ek'ūpacāro nāma ekakulassa gāmo hoti parikkhitto ca. antogāme cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā antogāme vatthabbaṃ.

17803.grammar: adj, masc nom & acc pl of eka

examples.text: yañ'hi eke jigucchanti, mataṃ disvāna pāpakaṃ, kāmarāgo pāturahu, andho'va savatī ahuṃ.
yam'āhu saccaṃ tathiyan'ti eke, tam'āhu aññe tucchaṃ musā'ti, evam'pi vigayha vivādayanti, kasmā na ekaṃ samaṇā vadanti.

17804.meaning1: one by one; individual; single; separate

examples.text: ek'ekalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, ek'ekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

vejayantassa kho, mārisa moggallāna, pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ. ek'ekasmiṃ niyyūhe satta satta kūṭ'āgārasatāni. ekam'ekasmiṃ kūṭ'āgāre satta satta accharāyo. ekam'ekissā accharāya satta satta paricārikāyo.

17806.meaning1: with individual body-hairs; thirteenth of the thirty-two marks of a great man

examples.text: ek'ekalomo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, ek'ekāni lomāni lomakūpesu jātāni, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

17808.meaning1: auspicious marks of having individual body-hairs and a tuft
17808.construction:
ekekalomatā + uṇṇā + lakkhaṇa + āni
ekekalomatāuṇṇālakkhaṇa + āni

17809.meaning1: having the quality of a single hair per pore

examples.text: setā susukkā mudutūlasannibhā, uṇṇā sujātā bhamuk'antare ahu, na lomakūpesu duve ajāyisuṃ, ek'ekalom'ūpacit'aṅgavā ahu.

17810.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ekeka

examples.text: cattālīsa samā dantā, kesā lomā ca sabbaso, devā hariṃsu ek'ekaṃ, cakkavāḷaparamparā'ti.
so araññato āgacchante mālākāre disvā thokaṃ thokaṃ phāṇitakhaṇḍaṃ datvā uḷuṅkena pānīyaṃ adāsi, te c'assa ek'ekaṃ pupphamuṭṭhiṃ adaṃsu.

17811.grammar: card, masc & nt instr sg of eka

examples.text: ekena'pi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, icchām'ahaṃ, bhikkhave, aḍḍhamāsaṃ paṭisallīyituṃ. n'āmhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā'ti.

17812.meaning1: by even one; with only a single

examples.text: ekena'pi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito, te ca bhikkhū gārayhā, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
kārāpeyyā'ti ekena'pi kosiy'aṃsunā missitvā karoti vā kārāpeti vā, payoge dukkaṭaṃ. paṭilābhena nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
saccaṃ, bhagavā'ti. vigarahi buddho bhagavā … kathañ'hi nāma, bhikkhave, bhikkhunī ratt'andhakāre appadīpe purisena saddhiṃ eken'ekā santiṭṭhissati'pi sallapissati'pi!

17815.meaning1: with just one; with only a single

examples.text: āyasmato dhammarakkhitassa santike tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ eken'eva uddesena tīhi māsehi byañjanaso pariyāpuṇitvā puna tīhi māsehi atthaso manas'ākāsi.
atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhibhariyāya sattavassikaṃ sīs'ābādhaṃ eken'eva natthukammena apakaḍḍhi.

17816.meaning1: (of a man and a woman) alone together
17816.commentary: (VIN 1.3.1) eko ekāyā'ti bhikkhu c'eva hoti mātugāmo ca.

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā udāyī yena sā kumārikā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tassā kumārikāya saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappesi kālayuttaṃ samullapanto kālayuttaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇanto
yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya

17817.meaning1: covered with water; one mass of water

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, ayaṃ mahāpathavī ek'odakā assa. tatra puriso ekacchiggaḷaṃ yugaṃ pakkhipeyya.

17818.meaning1: single mass of water; only water

examples.text: ek'odakībhūtaṃ kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena hoti andhakāro andhakāratimisā.

17820.commentary: (SNa) ekodi nipakā'ti ek'aggacittā c'eva paññānepakkena ca samannāgatā.

examples.text: tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati.
kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato, kammāro rajatass'eva, niddhame malam'attano.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yato kho bhikkhuno chasu phass'āyatanesu cittaṃ udujitaṃ hoti sudujitaṃ, ajjhattam'eva santiṭṭhati, sannisīdati, ekodi hoti, samādhiyati.

so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ'y'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. so hoti samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato na sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato.
kathañ'c'ānanda, bhikkhu ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapeti sannisādeti ekodikaroti samādahati?
vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāva-adhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.
tasmiṃ pahīne tasmiṃ byantīkate ath'āparaṃ dhammavitakk'āvasissati. so hoti samādhi na c'eva santo na ca paṇīto nappaṭippassaddhaladdho na ekodibhāv'ādhigato sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato hoti.
pañc'aṅgike samādhimhi, sante ekodibhāvite, paṭippassaddhiladdhamhi, dibbacakkhu visujjhi me.

17826.commentary: (SNa) ekodibhūtā'ti khaṇikasamādhinā ek'aggabhūtā. (SNPa) ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti so ek'aggacitto sabbaṃ mohāditamaṃ vihaneyya. n'atthi ettha saṃsayo. sesaṃ sabbattha pākaṭam'eva.

examples.text: etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto, kālena so sammā dhammaṃ parivīmaṃsamāno, ekodibhūto vihane tamaṃ so'ti.

tassa evaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahit'attassa viharato ye gehasitā sarasaṅkappā te pahīyanti. tesaṃ pahānā ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodibhoti samādhiyati. evaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāyagatāsatiṃ bhāveti.

17828.meaning2: is or becomes integrated, unified; is apart

examples.text: so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ'y'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodihoti samādhiyati.
so kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, ajjhattam'eva cittaṃ saṇṭhapemi sannisādemi ekodiṃ karomi samādahāmi. taṃ kissa hetu? mā me cittaṃ ūhaññī'ti.
mā, brāhmaṇa, paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ pamādo, paṭhame jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, paṭhame jhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, paṭhame jhāne cittaṃ samādahā'ti.
tesaṃ kho pana, bhikkhu, caturāsītiyā pāsādasahassānaṃ eko'y'eva so pāsādo hoti yam'ahaṃ tena samayena ajjhāvasāmi, dhammo pāsādo.
eko'va bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye viharitu'kāmo hoti na bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye kenaci anubandhitabbo hotī'ti
eko'va indo asure jināti, eko'va seno hanti dije pasayha, eko'va byaggho migasaṅghapatto, varaṃ varaṃ hanti balañ'hi tādisaṃ.

17832.meaning1: in reference to SN35.90 Paṭhamaejāsutta & SN35.91 Dutiyaejāsutta

examples.text: palokasuññā saṃkhittaṃ, channo puṇṇo ca bāhiyo, ejena ca duve vuttā, dvayehi apare duve'ti.
etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, dukkhaṃ iñjitapaccayā, tasmā hi ejaṃ vossajja, saṅkhāre uparundhiya, anejo anupādāno, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.
purimaṃ pahāya aparaṃ sitāse, ej'ānugā te na taranti saṅgaṃ, te uggahāyanti nirassajanti, kapī'va sākhaṃ pamuñcaṃ gahāyaṃ.

17835.meaning1: following one's impulses; running after desire

examples.text: purimaṃ pahāya aparaṃ sitāse, ej'ānugā te na taranti saṅgaṃ, te uggahāyanti nirassajanti, kapī'va sākhaṃ pamuñcaṃ gahāyaṃ.
eṇijaṅgho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti
yaṃ eṇikūlasmiṃ janaṃ gahītaṃ, amocayī gayhakaṃ nīyamānaṃ, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmi.

17839.meaning1: with calves like an antelope; with haunches like a deer; eighth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
17839.commentary: (MNa) eṇijaṅgho'ti eṇimigasadisajaṅgho maṃs'ussadena paripuṇṇajaṅgho. (SNa) eṇijaṅghan'ti eṇimigassa viya suvaṭṭitajaṅghaṃ.

examples.text: eṇijaṅgho kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
eṇijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ, app'āhāraṃ alolupaṃ, sīhaṃ'v'ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ, kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ, upasaṅkamma pucchāma, kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatī'ti

17840.meaning1: auspicious mark of having antelope calves
17840.commentary: (DNa) tathāgatassa pana sakkaccaṃ vācitabhāvaṃ sadevako loko iminā kāraṇena jānātū'ti anupubba-uggatavaṭṭitaṃ eṇijaṅghalakkhaṇaṃ nibbattati.

17841.meaningLit: discourse on having calves like an antelope

examples.text: varāhaeṇeyyavigāḷhasevite, pabbhārakuṭṭe pakat'eva sundare, nav'ambunā pāvusasitthakānane, tahiṃ guhāgehagato ramissasi.

17845.commentary: (MNa) eṇeyyakan'ti eṇeyyakakammakāraṇaṃ. taṃ karontā ubhosu kapparesu ca jāṇūsu ca ayavalayāni datvā ayasūlāni koṭṭenti. so catūhi ayasūlehi bhūmiyaṃ patiṭṭhahati. atha naṃ parivāretvā aggiṃ karonti.

examples.text: tam'enaṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakāraṇā kārenti… cīrakavāsikam'pi karonti, eṇeyyakam'pi karonti, baḷisamaṃsikam'pi karonti, kahāpaṇikam'pi karonti, khārāpatacchikam'pi karonti, palighaparivattikam'pi karonti

17846.meaning1: with calves like a black antelope

examples.text: eṇeyyajaṅgho'ti tam'āhu puggalaṃ, sampattiyā khippam'idh'āhu lakkhaṇaṃ, geh'ānulomāni yad'ābhikaṅkhati, apabbajaṃ khippam'idh'ādhigacchati.
dūrato'pi kho mayaṃ, āvuso, āgaccheyyāma āyasmato sāriputtassa santike etassa bhāsitassa attham'aññātuṃ
accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.

17849.meaning2: having longings for this, desiring this

17850.meaning1: having this field; within this domain
17850.commentary: (MNa) etaṃ patho'ham'asmi etaṃ gocaro'ti esa mayhaṃ patho esa gocaro'ti attho.

examples.text: ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā'ti? byākaramāno, bhikkhave, tathāgato evaṃ byākareyya, ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassa, etapatho'ham'asmi etagocaro, no ca tena tam'mayo'ti.

17851.meaning1: because of this; for this reason

17852.synonym: imañca, cidaṃ, cimaṃ, cetaṃ, cesa, ceso, panesā

examples.text: etañ'ca sallaṃ paṭikacca disvā, ajjhositā yattha pajā visattā. jānāmi passāmi tath'eva etaṃ, ajjhositaṃ n'atthi tathāgatānan'ti.
etañ'ca dhammam'aññāya, vicinaṃ bhikkhu sadā sato sikkhe, santī'ti nibbutiṃ ñatvā, sāsane gotamassa na pamajjeyya.
es'eva maggo n'atth'añño, dassanassa visuddhiyā, etañ'hi tumhe paṭipajjatha, mārass'etaṃ pamohanaṃ.
etañ'hi tumhe paṭipannā, dukkhass'antaṃ karissatha, akkhāto vo mayā maggo, aññāya sallakantanaṃ.

17854.grammar: pron, masc abl sg of eta

examples.text: sace'pi etato bhiyyo, āgamissanti itthiyo, n'eva maṃ byādhayissanti, dhamme samhi patiṭṭhitaṃ.

17855.grammar: pron, in comps, nt acc sg of eta
17855.notes: archaic form of etaṃ found in compounds and idiom

examples.text: etadaññāya ye satā, diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā, na te māravas'ānugā, na te mārassa paddhagū'ti.
etadaggaṃ paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānaṃ paññapentānaṃ yadidaṃ channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca.

17856.meaning1: this is the best; this is the highest

17857.meaning2: Chapter on 'This is the Number One'

17858.meaningLit: section on this is the best

17859.meaning1: this is the greatest; this is the best; this is the highest (of)
17859.commentary: (VIN 1.2.4) etadaggan'ti etaṃ aggaṃ etaṃ seṭṭhaṃ etaṃ mokkhaṃ etaṃ uttamaṃ etaṃ pavaraṃ.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ bhagini pāricariyānaṃ yā mādisaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ brahmacāriṃ etena dhammena paricareyyā'ti methun'upasaṃhitena, saṅgh'ādiseso.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇ'āyatanānaṃ yadidaṃ viññāṇakasiṇaṃ eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. evaṃsaññino'pi kho, bhikkhave, santi sattā.

17860.commentary: (NIDD2) etadaññāya ye satā'ti. etan'ti amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. aññāyā'ti aññāya jānitvā tulayitvā tīrayitvā vibhāvayitvā vibhūtaṃ katvā. (SNPa) etadaññāya ye satā'ti etaṃ nibbānapadam'accutaṃ sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā'ti-ādinā nayena vipassantā anupubbena jānitvā ye kāyānupassanāsatiādīhi satā. diṭṭhadhamm'ābhinibbutā'ti viditadhammattā, diṭṭhadhammattā, rāgādinibbānena ca abhinibbutā. sesaṃ sabbattha pākaṭam'eva.

examples.text: ye etadaññāya padaṃ asaṅkhataṃ, vimuttacittā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, te dhammasār'ādhigamā khaye ratā, pahaṃsu te sabbabhavāni tādino'ti.
aññāt'atthaṃ pasād'atthaṃ, sataṃ ve hoti mantanā, evaṃ kho ariyā mantenti, esā ariyāna mantanā, etadaññāya medhāvī, na samusseyya mantaye'ti.
etadatthā, bhikkhave, kathā, etadatthā mantanā, etadatthā upanisā, etadatthaṃ sot'āvadhānaṃ, yadidaṃ anupādā cittassa vimokkho'ti.
akuppā cetovimutti etadattham'idaṃ brāhmaṇa brahmacariyaṃ

17863.meaning2: having this purpose; useful for this

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, kim'atthiyā koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā'ti? ye ca, bhante, koliyānaṃ corā te ca paṭisedhetuṃ, yāni ca koliyānaṃ dūteyyāni tāni ca vahātuṃ, etadatthiyā, bhante, koliyānaṃ lambacūḷakā bhaṭā'ti.

17864.meaning1: ending here; finishing thus; concluding here
17864.meaning2: having this as an end, having an end here; ending thus
17864.commentary: (THIa) etadantikā'ti etaṃ idāni mayā adhigataṃ arahattaṃ anto pariyosānaṃ etesan'ti etadantikā, sokā. na dāni tesaṃ sambhavo atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe sokā samucchinnā, pahīnā etadantikā, pariññātā hi me vatthū, yato sokāna sambhavo'ti.
kiṃ pana, brāhmaṇa, sabbo loko brāhmaṇānaṃ etadabbhanujānāti, imā catasso pāricariyā paññapentū'ti.
taṃ tathāvādiniṃ buddho, mamaṃ so etadabravi, na h'evaṃ vandiyā buddhā, yathā vandasi gotamī.

17867.grammar: aor 3rd pl of etadabravi, comp vb

examples.text: tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ, satthāni nikkhipitvāna, māṇavā etadabravuṃ.

17868.commentary: (MNa) bhagavā etadavocā'ti bhagavā etaṃ idāni vattabbaṃ sakalaṃ suttaṃ avoca.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu there bhikkhū etadavoca, phasso kho, āvuso, eko anto, phassasamudayo dutiyo anto, phassanirodho majjhe, taṇhā sibbinī.
idh'āhaṃ, bhante, yen'aññataro bhikkhu ten'upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocaṃ, kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, bhikkhuno dassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ hotī'ti?
tassa mayhaṃ āvuso, etadahosi, idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etadahosi, atippago kho tāva sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ. yaṃnūna mayaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten'upasaṅkameyyāmā'ti.

17870.meaning1: this is the highest; this is the ultimate

examples.text: etadānuttariyaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇānaṃ yadidaṃ tattha tattha yathābhūtañāṇaṃ. etasmā c'āhaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇā aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā n'atthī'ti vadāmi.

17871.meaning1: just this; only this; this exact

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubb'upagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
etadeva, bhante, bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ mahāpathavī. appamattako'yaṃ bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyaṃ paṃsu āropito.

17873.meaning1: having this range; with this domain
17873.commentary: (MNa) etaṃ patho'ham'asmi etaṃ gocaro'ti esa mayhaṃ patho esa gocaro'ti attho. et'āpātho'ti'pi pāṭho, tass'attho mayhaṃ ājīv'aṭṭhamakasīlaṃ parisuddhaṃ, sv'āhaṃ tassa parisuddhabhāvena vīmaṃsakassa bhikkhuno ñāṇamukhe et'āpātho, evaṃ āpāthaṃ gacchāmī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti vā te tathāgatassa no vā'ti? byākaramāno, bhikkhave, tathāgato evaṃ byākareyya, ye vodātā cakkhusotaviññeyyā dhammā, saṃvijjanti te tathāgatassa, etapatho'ham'asmi etagocaro, no ca tena tam'mayo'ti.

17874.meaning1: this size at most; maximum this large

17882.commentary: (MNa) yo etam'abhijānātī'ti yo etaṃ vimānavatthuṃ jānātī'ti attho. evam'ettha vimānapetavatthukene'va attho veditabbo. (THa) yo etam'abhijānātī'ti yo mah'ābhiñño etaṃ kammaphalañ'ca hatthatale ṭhapita-āmalakaṃ viya abhimukhaṃ katvā paccakkhato jānāti. (THa) yo etam'abhijānātī'ti yo etaṃ vimānaṃ vatthuṃ paccakkhaṃ katvā jānāti. ayañ'hi attho vimānapetavatthūhi dīpetabbo. (THa) yo etam'abhijānātī'ti etaṃ yathāvuttaṃ vimokkhaṃ phusanakaraṇavasena jānāti.

examples.text: yo etam'abhijānāti, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, tādisaṃ bhikkhum'āsajja, kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasi.
etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, parisuddhakāyakammataṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.
tatra vata maṃ bhayaṃ vā sārajjaṃ vā okkamissatī'ti nimittam'etaṃ, sāriputta, na samanupassāmi. etam'ahaṃ, sāriputta, nimittaṃ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.

17884.meaning1: this danger; this disadvantage; this risk; this peril
17884.commentary: (ITIa) etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, taṇhaṃ dukkhassa sambhavan'ti etaṃ sakalavaṭṭadukkhassa sambhavaṃ samudayaṃ taṇhaṃ ādīnavaṃ ādīnavato ñatvā'ti attho. atha vā etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā'ti etaṃ yathāvuttaṃ saṃsāran'ātivattanaṃ ādīnavaṃ dosaṃ ñatvā.

examples.text: etam'ādīnavaṃ ñatvā, taṇhaṃ dukkhassa sambhavaṃ, vītataṇho anādāno, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.
ete vivādā samaṇesu jātā, etesu ugghāti nighāti hoti, etam'pi disvā virame kath'ojjaṃ, na h'añña'd'atth'atthi pasaṃsalābhā.
yā uṇṇatī s'āssa vighātabhūmi, mān'ātimānaṃ vadate pan'eso, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.
